description: A proposal run must return a single valid JSON object carrying at least 3 candidates, each with a kind from the fixed set.

input.topic: New and newly-emerging competitive moves among South African data-and-analytics competitors
input.watchlist_note: South African IT trade press (ITWeb, BusinessLive, Moneyweb) and the National Treasury eTenders portal.

expected_output.shape: single JSON object with keys profile_id, candidates

rubric.condition: The entire output parses as a single JSON object with json.loads and no surrounding prose or markdown fences.
The candidates array contains at least 3 items.
Every candidate's source_kind is one of the six fixed strings.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md's Output contract and hard rule 1.
